say:1:1211319001:1.text: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.
say:1:1211319001:1.source_cn: 躲在阴影里的老鼠。终于现身了。
say:1:1211319001:1.male: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.
say:1:1211319001:1.female: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.

say:3:1211319002:1.text: That chat back at the camp was just a ploy to lure us here?
say:3:1211319002:1.source_cn: ……原来如此。刚才在营地里那番话是故意讲给我们听的，为...

say:4:1211319003:1.text: I figured your brains had decayed long ago in the seawater.
say:4:1211319003:1.source_cn: 我还以为死潮舰队的脑子早就在海水里泡烂了。

say:7:1211319004:0.text: Dear Bonnie, do you not see the perfect opportunity to test our latest technology?
say:7:1211319004:0.source_cn: 亲爱的波妮，不觉得这是个试用新技术的好时机吗？

say:10:1211319005:1.text: You don't need to jump in. I can handle this alone.
say:10:1211319005:1.source_cn: 不用你动手，我自己就可以对付他们。

say:11:1211319006:1.text: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
say:11:1211319006:1.source_cn: 可惜，这么多鲜活的肉体……
say:11:1211319006:1.male: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
say:11:1211319006:1.female: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...

choice_prompt:12:1211319006.male: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
choice_prompt:12:1211319006.female: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...

say:15:1211319007:1.text: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!
say:15:1211319007:1.source_cn: 没在刚才发动突袭，将是你们做出的最错误的决定！
say:15:1211319007:1.male: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!
say:15:1211319007:1.female: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!

choice:12:0:1.text: You think you can take us on alone?
choice:12:0:1.male: You think you can take us on alone?
choice:12:0:1.female: You think you can take us on alone?

choice:12:2:3.text: This will end badly for you.
choice:12:2:3.male: This will end badly for you.
choice:12:2:3.female: This will end badly for you.
